q: How do we count emissions from technicians visiting customer sites?
title: Field service visit emissions
short: It follows who owns the vehicle. Company vehicles are Scope 1 from their fuel invoices. Technicians using their own vehicles and claiming mileage are Scope 3 Category 6, as are taxis, trains and hotel nights. A contracted service partner's emissions are part of what you buy, Scope 3 Category 1.
audience: Companies with installation and service teams

ul: Mileage claims with km per trip.

p: Divide the year's service emissions by the number of visits if a customer asks for a per-visit number, and say what is included.

senseible: Senseible reads supplier invoices into dated records with the quantity, unit and factor on each line, and marks lines without a usable quantity as needing data instead of guessing.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
